A '''planet''' notable for its seven rings.<ref name="SW24" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> this [[Planet/Legends|world]] was home to a individual of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Unidentified species (seven-ringed homeworld)|species]].<ref name="SW24" />

==Behind the scenes==
This world was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars (1977) 24|twenty-fourth]] issue of the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'']] series of comics.<ref name="SW24" />
